chart-cards-view.title: Chart Cards
chart-cards-view.description: Free chart-card recipes for the Sales Report: compose solaris-card slots with sparklines and charts. Prefer chart-shell when view, period, or legend switching is needed.

recipes.note: Three Sales Report recipes built on plain solaris-card slots — no new wrapper component. Every recipe pairs the visual chart with a totals table for screen readers and print.

pattern.note: Free chart-card = solaris-card (padding md) + header slot (title, description) + content slot (KPI row, chart, totals table). The shell owns switching (view/period/legend/display); the free card owns layout. Never nest a chart-shell inside a chart-card recipe — pick one wrapper per card.
pattern.whenFree: Use a free card for fixed Sales Report layouts: KPI + sparkline, single chart + table, target vs goal.
pattern.whenShell: Use chart-shell when the user switches views, periods, display modes, or toggles legend series.

installation.note: Install the package and import the standalone card and chart components.
